claim: The sample safety shield blocks laser light scattered off the sample and is to be placed around the sample before the laser is activated. If it gets in the way of other equipment on the stage, the operator must provide a replacement or other protection at least as good.
validity_conditions: Read from Tweez 305/310 System Installation Guide, 2021 (sha256 1f664a72..., byte-identical in the installed folder and the lab archive): printed page 22 (PDF page 26). Also Tweez 305/310 Laser Safety Manual V3.0, November 2022, as installed in C:/Program Files/Aresis/Tweez300/Manuals/ (sha256 264ab54b...): printed page 2 (PDF page 4). E3 vendor_spec: the manufacturer's statement, not an observation on this bench. The Laser Safety Manual lists a protective shield as available on request. KNOWLEDGE, NOT POLICY: this is what the manufacturer says. What any session may do, and every limit anyone here acts on, is the person's, written into the envelope after confirming it on the instrument.
